next.reason: 1985: 'Format 1 must be used for all files in sequential access mode.' 2023 reaches the same result by implication: §2023:14.9.30.3 SR8 'If neither the NEXT phrase nor the PREVIOUS phrase is specified and ACCESS MODE SEQUENTIAL is specified ... the NEXT phrase is implied', and §2023:14.9.30.4 GR19 'An implicit or explicit NEXT phrase or a PREVIOUS phrase results in a sequential read'. Every READ on a sequential-access file is therefore a format 1 (sequential) READ, and the format 2 KEY and INVALID KEY phrases have no place in it. A conforming 1985 program means the same.
